analyst.summary: RITES is a high-quality, debt-free railway consultancy and engineering PSU with strong returns on capital (around 20-24% ROE/ROCE) trading at a reasonable 25-26 times earnings. Growth has been genuinely weak over the past three to five years due to government-capex-cycle dependence and softer consultancy revenue, but the most recent year shows a growth recovery and new contract wins. Given the balance-sheet quality and reasonable valuation, we move this from a quant Sell to a Hold.
